proposal.mixer_type: Static mixer or T-mixer with back-pressure retention
proposal.mixing_order_reasoning: From Chemistry Plan: H2 gas and liquid substrate mixed before entering packed bed to ensure saturation. Engineering calculations indicate Da > 1, so efficient mixing is critical to avoid mass transfer limitations.
pre_reactor_steps: Mix Stream A (Liquid) and Stream B (H2 Gas) using a static mixer or gas-liquid contactor.
Heat mixture to 50 C using a pre-heater coil or jacketed mixer.
Apply back-pressure to maintain system pressure at 10 bar (via BPR downstream) to ensure H2 solubility.
post_reactor_steps: Pass effluent through a filter or frit to retain Pd/C catalyst particles.
Depressurize via BPR (set to 10 bar) to vent excess H2 safely.
proposal.chemistry_notes: Heterogeneous hydrogenation of alkene over Pd/C. Gas-liquid-solid system. Engineering calculations indicate significant axial dispersion (Pe=92) and mass transfer limitations (Da=6.24). A packed bed reactor is required for catalyst retention. BPR is mandatory to maintain H2 solubility and prevent degassing. No photochemistry involved. Temperature 50 C is moderate, requiring PFA or SS tubing.

reasoning_per_field.BPR_bar: Engineering Design Calculations Step 8: BPR REQUIRED. Batch condition is 10 bar H2. BPR set to 10 bar to maintain pressure and H2 solubility.
reasoning_per_field.tubing_material: PFA is suitable for 50 C and chemical compatibility with ethanol/H2. SS could also be used but PFA allows for easier packing and cleaning.
reasoning_per_field.concentration_M: From Batch Input: 0.1 M. Maintained to match batch kinetics and avoid mass transfer issues at higher concentrations.

reasoning_per_field.tubing_ID_mm: Engineering Design Calculations Step 3: d = 1.00 mm. This ID balances pressure drop and axial dispersion.
reasoning_per_field.reactor_volume_mL: Engineering Design Calculations Step 3: V_R = 26.67 mL. Calculated from tau and flow rate.

case.title: Hydrogenation over a packed bed
case.protocol: A 0.10 M ethanol solution of an alkene is hydrogenated over 5 wt% Pd/C at 50 C and 10 bar hydrogen for 4 h in batch. Design a continuous packed-bed process with gas-liquid mixing, catalyst retention, pressure control, and startup/shutdown safeguards.
case.notes: FlowPilot ablation case; source flow answer withheld.

batch_record.reaction_description: Hydrogenation of an alkene over 5 wt% Pd/C
batch_record.raw_text: A 0.10 M ethanol solution of an alkene is hydrogenated over 5 wt% Pd/C at 50 C and 10 bar hydrogen for 4 h in batch. Design a continuous packed-bed process with gas-liquid mixing, catalyst retention, pressure control, and startup/shutdown safeguards.

chemistry_plan.mixing_order_reasoning: H2 gas and liquid substrate mixed before entering packed bed to ensure saturation.
chemistry_plan.deoxygenation_reasoning: Not strictly required for hydrogenation, but O2 can compete for active sites or pose explosion risk with H2.
chemistry_plan.quench_reasoning: Reaction stops upon H2 removal or catalyst separation.
chemistry_plan.confidence_notes: Standard industrial process; high confidence in flow adaptation.

intensification_mandate.flow_justification_basis: Flow must demonstrate 20.0x residence-time reduction. Identified batch limitations: mass_transfer_gas_liquid. Primary flow advantage: mass_transfer. Mechanisms: gas-liquid kLa enhancement (segmented flow), selectivity-sensitive stream logic. Limitation-driven IF (20x) exceeds class default (2x).

steps.name: Batch Conditions
assumptions: Intensification policy active downstream → tau_flow must remain ≤ 240.0 min

steps.name: Kinetics & Residence Time
steps.summary: τ = 8.0 min, range [5.3–12.0] min, via class (mass_transfer_gas_liquid) (IF = 30×)
assumptions: IF = 30× from hydrogenation class median (no analogy data available)

steps.name: Reactor Sizing
steps.summary: V_R = 26.67 mL, d = 1.00 mm, L = 33.95 m, Pe = 92 (⚠ axial dispersion)
warnings: Pe = 92 < 100 — significant axial dispersion. Reactor behaves closer to CSTR than PFR. Reduce d (smaller d → higher Pe) or accept lower conversion efficiency.

steps.name: Mass Transfer
steps.summary: t_mix = 101.3 s, Da = 6.241 — Transition zone — mixing becoming significant
warnings: Da = 6.24 > 1: mixing may limit conversion. Consider static mixer insert.
assumptions: D = 1e-09 m²/s (typical for small organic molecules in liquid)
Gas holdup estimated from actual reactor gas/liquid volumetric ratio.
O2 solubility uses a water/ethanol-scale Henry-law approximation; validate experimentally for final scale-up.
kLa is a conservative capillary slug-flow estimate tied to gas holdup.

steps.name: Heat Transfer
steps.summary: Q_gen = 0.2996 W, Q_rem = 320.0004 W, Da_th = 0.0009 — Thermally safe

steps.name: Back-Pressure Regulator
steps.summary: BPR REQUIRED: 3.0 bar (Gas-liquid system detected — BPR mandatory to maintain gas solubility (Henry's law: C_gas = H·P) and prevent uncontrolled degassing.)
equations: C_{\mathrm{gas}} = H \cdot P_{\mathrm{partial}}\quad\text{(higher BPR} \Rightarrow \text{more dissolved gas)}
